test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.**

After hours of persistent pursuit and percecution, the little prince was at last deserted by the rabble and left to himself.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Percecution."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is** "persecution."**
 
• The word means the act of harassing or oppressing someone, usually because of their beliefs or race. (अत्‍याचार, उत्‍पीड़न)
 
 
• **Example**: *They left the country out of fear of **persecution**__.*
 
 
 
• The error in spelling could be due to a typo or a lack of familiarity with the word.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Persistent)** is spelled correctly and means continuing to exist or endure over a long period of time. (लंबे समय तक अस्तित्व में रहना या कायम रहना)
 
• **Option 2 (Rabble)** is spelled correctly and means a disorderly crowd of people. (शोरगुल करती या हिंसा पर उतारू भीड़; असंगठित भीड़)
 
• **Option 4 (Deserted)** is spelled correctly and means abandoned or left alone. (वीरान, परित्‍यक्त)
